text:
laura: Heads-up — working on a followup to the quota/fairness RFC. Thinking about a 'rate curve' gating layer for tenant slowdowns instead of hard evictions. Quick sync?

mike: +1. want to avoid sudden evictions. idea: per-tenant token-bucket but with a dynamic refill curve + admission multiplier. route uses 'gating' signal to adjust priority.

deepa: how is this different from soft-shed / provisional tokens we already have?

laura: soft-shed today is pretty binary (we flip degrade when pressure high). gating would be continuous: once utilization crosses ramp_start we gradually reduce admission probability from 1 -> 0 across a window. smoother UX for low-latency apps.

jon: telemetry needs: per-tenant p95 token consumption curve, current refill rate, and headroom. if we can't observe curve well we may mis-ramp. also make token-state store zonal and low-latency.

mike: rough config sketch (proto):
```
gating:
  window: 60s       # sliding window for utilization
  ramp_start: 0.7   # fraction of provisioned capacity to begin ramp
  ramp_end: 1.2     # fraction at which admission -> 0
  function: linear  # linear/exp/sigmoid curve options
  metric: tenant_util_pct
```

mike: routing pseudo: if gating.active -> admission_prob = curve(util), then sample before enqueue. fallback: if critical tier && prob<thresh -> route to dedicated pool.

deepa: how do we prevent tenants from gaming shape (e.g., split traffic across many small clients to avoid util metric)? any abuse signals to combine?

laura: combine with abuse heuristics: burst-pattern detector, account-wide aggregates, and reputation score. gating multiplier = curve(util) * reputation_discount. reputation_discount in [0,1]. also add cooldown windows and fast decay so transient spikes don't permanently punish.

jon: test plan: staging rollout with synthetic tenants that emulate bursty vs steady. instrument p50/p95 tail latency, admission_ratio, and error_rate. dashboard per-tenant + aggregate.

infra-bot: deploy status: gating-proxy v0.1 deployed to staging (canary 10%).

mike: ops concerns: need an override for SRE to pause gating per-region, and a kill-switch that reverts to soft-shed fast. also ensure we log sampled-deny reasons for postmortem.

laura: next steps: prototype gating curve code in admission-service, push metric exports (tenant_util_pct + admission_prob), build dashboard. I'll open a tracking ticket and a short RFC addendum with config API.

deepa: ack. i'll scope tests and add abuse-signal mapping.

jon: i'll add runbook snippets for override and rollback.

laura: thanks all — will share the RFC addendum tomorrow. :thumbsup:
